label: Pathways with a Particular Gene
description: Lists all pathways per instance of a particular gene or protein (wp:GeneProduct), here all gene products whose label contains "CYP".
query:
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?pathway (str(?label) as ?geneProduct)
WHERE {
    ?gene a wp:GeneProduct .
    ?gene rdfs:label ?label .
    ?gene dcterms:isPartOf ?pathway .
    ?pathway a wp:Pathway .

    FILTER regex(str(?label), "CYP").
}
